description: This file is a Perl module (Git.pm) that provides an interface to interact with the Git version control system. It includes methods for executing Git commands, managing repositories, parsing configuration, handling credentials, and other Git operations.

classes.name: Git::Error::Command
classes.description: Custom exception class representing errors from executing external Git commands, encapsulating command line, exit code, and output details.

methods.name: repository
methods.description: Constructs and returns a Git repository object, determining the repository type and paths based on provided options or current directory.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Executes a Git command with optional arguments, returning output based on context (scalar or list).

methods.name: command_oneline
methods.description: Executes a Git command and returns only the first line of stdout as a scalar string.

methods.name: command_output_pipe
methods.description: Runs a Git command and provides a filehandle to read its output.

methods.name: command_input_pipe
methods.description: Runs a Git command and provides a writable pipe to send input to it.

methods.name: command_close_pipe
methods.description: Closes and checks a pipe obtained from command_output_pipe or command_input_pipe.

methods.name: command_bidi_pipe
methods.description: Executes a command with pipes for bidirectional communication, returning process ID and filehandles.

methods.name: command_close_bidi_pipe
methods.description: Closes bidirectional pipes, waits for completion, and checks for errors.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the current version of Git in use.

methods.name: exec_path
methods.description: Returns the path to Git's executable directory.

methods.name: html_path
methods.description: Returns the path to Git's HTML documentation directory.

methods.name: get_tz_offset
methods.description: Calculates and returns the local timezone offset in +/-HHMM format.

methods.name: get_record
methods.description: Reads a record from a filehandle delimited by a specified separator.

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Prompts user input securely or interactively, respecting environment variables.

methods.name: repo_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the associated Git repository.

methods.name: wc_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the working copy directory.

methods.name: wc_subdir
methods.description: Returns the subdirectory within the working copy.

methods.name: wc_chdir
methods.description: Changes the working copy subdirectory.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration variable values from Git.

methods.name: config_bool
methods.description: Retrieves boolean configuration variables from Git.

methods.name: config_path
methods.description: Retrieves path configuration variables and returns expanded path.

methods.name: config_int
methods.description: Retrieves integer configuration variables, supports unit suffixes.

methods.name: config_regexp
methods.description: Retrieves list of config keys matching a regular expression.

methods.name: get_colorbool
methods.description: Checks if color output should be used for a named operation.

methods.name: get_color
methods.description: Retrieves color codes for configuration slots.

methods.name: remote_refs
methods.description: Retrieves remote references from a remote repository.

methods.name: ident
methods.description: Retrieves and parses author or committer identification info from Git.

methods.name: ident_person
methods.description: Extracts the person component (name and email) from ident info.

methods.name: hash_object
methods.description: Calculates the SHA1 hash of a file considering its type.

methods.name: hash_and_insert_object
methods.description: Hashes a file and inserts it into the Git object database.

methods.name: cat_blob
methods.description: Outputs the contents of a blob object to a filehandle.

methods.name: port_num
methods.description: Converts a port or service name to its numeric value.

methods.name: credential_read
methods.description: Reads credential key-value pairs from a filehandle.

methods.name: credential_write
methods.description: Writes credential key-value pairs to a filehandle.

methods.name: credential
methods.description: Runs git credential subcommands or interacts with credential helper.

methods.name: temp_acquire
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a temporary file handle associated with a name, locks it.

methods.name: temp_is_locked
methods.description: Checks if a temp file handle associated with a name is locked.

methods.name: temp_release
methods.description: Releases a lock on a temp file handle, optionally truncates.

methods.name: temp_reset
methods.description: Truncates and resets a temp file handle.

methods.name: temp_path
methods.description: Returns the filename of a temp file handle or by name.

methods.name: prefix_lines
methods.description: Prefixes each line of input string with a specified prefix.

methods.name: unquote_path
methods.description: Unescapes path strings with C-escape sequences.

methods.name: get_comment_line_char
methods.description: Retrieves the comment character from core.commentchar configuration.

methods.name: comment_lines
methods.description: Prefixes lines with the comment character.

methods.name: _maybe_self
methods.description: Helper to determine if method called on an object or class.

methods.name: _check_valid_cmd
methods.description: Validates that a command name is a safe and reasonable string.

methods.name: _command_common_pipe
methods.description: Underlying implementation for creating pipes.

methods.name: _execv_git_cmd
methods.description: Executes the git command with provided arguments.

methods.name: _is_sig
methods.description: Checks if a signal number corresponds to a specific Unix signal.

methods.name: _cmd_close
methods.description: Closes pipes and checks for command execution errors.

methods.name: _setup_git_cmd_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables and working directory for Git command execution.
